name: Kanaibazar district road

route.end: Junction with MDR KJ-M-6 near the Bangladesh border, Assam

tollInfo.note: District roads in India are not tolled.

significance: A major district road in Karimganj district, Assam, running north-west from NH 8 at Kanaibazar to meet MDR KJ-M-6 and KJ-M-11 near the Bangladesh border. Assam renumbered its district roads in 2023 and 2024, so older maps and signboards may carry a different number.
